title: Polynomial-time padding decoder
statement: The function on bit strings that sends $z$ to $\operatorname{pad}(\pi_1(z),\pi_2(z))$ is polynomial-time computable, where $\pi_1,\pi_2$ are the total projections associated with the self-delimiting pair encoding. Here $\operatorname{pad}(s,v)$ returns the prefix before the last true bit of $v$ when that prefix exists and has length $|s|$, and returns $s$ otherwise.
